scope: Complete tracked-file/ref inventory; selected runtime semantic inspection, not semantic verification of every branch. Inventory generated before audit commit.
inventory_limitations: SQL declarations and route decorators are a text inventory, not a live schema or full HTTP route export.
Remote refs include old and superseded drafts; ref count is not a feature count.
Each branch head is captured, but not every branch has been semantically reviewed or executed.
Runtime path memberships use zero-based indices into branch_heads.
